# TermJobs — Contract Workforce & VMS Platform

> TermJobs (`https://www.termjobs.in/`) is an enterprise-grade contract staffing, vendor management system (VMS), and flexible workforce operating platform. It connects Client Enterprises, Staffing Vendor Consultancies, and Contract Professionals into one transparent, automated hiring and billing ecosystem.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Contract Requisitions**: Requisitions created with structured budgets, bill rates, markup limits, and instant distribution to approved staffing agencies with a 48-hour sourcing window.
- **AI-Powered Candidate Screening**: Deep resume parsing, technical skills scoring, GitHub activity verification, and automated shortlist recommendations.
- **Integrated Video Interviews**: Built-in encrypted WebRTC video rooms with automated transcription, speech heuristics (speaking pace, filler words), and competency rubrics.
- **Clickwrap Work Orders & SOWs**: Formal offer generation, digital acceptance, and commercial work order sign-offs between Enterprise Clients and Staffing Vendors.
- **Onboarding & Compliance**: Automated background verification (BGV), bank/tax checklist verification, and secure equipment tracking.
- **Workforce Timesheets & Invoicing**: Weekly time tracking with 0.5-hour increments, dual manager approval workflows, overtime calculation, automated vendor invoicing, and finance payment clearing.

## Key System Roles & Portals

1. **Super Admin**: Enterprise tenant management, staffing agency network management, cross-tenant talent pool, and outreach automation.
2. **Company Admin**: Internal department setup, hiring manager / director permissions, and vendor partner allocations.
3. **Hiring Manager**: Requisition creation, candidate review, AI shortlists, technical interview scheduling, and timesheet approvals.
4. **Director / Executive**: Commercial approval for high-budget requisitions, master service agreements, and work order budgets.
5. **Vendor / Staffing Agency**: Sourcing talent, submitting candidate profiles against live client requisitions, compliance tracking, and monthly billing reconciliation.
6. **Procurement**: Statements of work (SOW) compliance, commercial rate cards, and vendor agreement oversight.
7. **Finance**: Invoice review, automated payment disbursements, expense audits, and remittance advices.
8. **Candidate / Contractor**: Application tracking, offer acceptance, onboarding credentials, daily time capture, and timesheet submission.
9. **Interviewer / Staff**: Candidate evaluation panel, competency scoring, and interview feedback.

## Public Web Endpoints

- **Homepage**: `https://www.termjobs.in/` — Overview of the contract workforce platform, enterprise solutions, and staffing vendor network.
- **Open Roles**: `https://www.termjobs.in/open-roles` — Real-time live contract positions, skill requirements, compensation rates, and 1-click applications.
- **Portal Sign In**: `https://www.termjobs.in/login` — Authentication gateway for candidates, hiring managers, staffing agencies, and enterprise staff.
